title: AI37 A2A routing extension v1
description: Compact semantic routing profile embedded in Agent Card capabilities.extensions. The $id is an identifier, not a network endpoint. Continuation of an open HITL/wizard is orchestrator mode, not an intent. Base phrases are Russian; the optional `i18n` map adds domains and excludes in other languages (additive: consumers that ignore it keep the Russian base).

i18n.description: Domains and excludes in other languages, keyed by BCP-47 tag. Intents are codes and are not translated. A consumer checks the base plus the entries along the locale chain of the turn (exact tag → language → declared fallback); a translation only adds phrases. A key that is not a BCP-47 tag or a malformed list is dropped, the profile survives.
